messages:
sarah-cs: FYI received a customer escalation — their client-side token estimator shows ~190 tokens but the API response `usage.total_tokens` is 320 and their invoice matches 320. Customer says this started after they added a tool that returns structured JSON.

jordan-eng: can you paste a minimal repro (curl + SDK snippet) and the API response headers?

sarah-cs: repro below. I redacted PII. They call with function-calling enabled and a system message. SDK estimate call: 
```python
from redwood_sdk import Client
client = Client(token=REDACTED)
resp = client.estimate_tokens(messages=[{"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant."}, {"role":"user","content":"Summarize the dataset"}], include_completion=True)
# estimator returned: 187
```
And the direct API response payload (returned body):
```json
{"id":"req_123","object":"response","choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"{...long JSON tool output...}"}}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":80,"completion_tokens":240,"total_tokens":320}}
```
Headers: `x-request-id: req_123` `x-token-count: 320`

metering-bot: metering pipeline processed request req_123 at 2026-03-17T15:02:10Z, final count 320 (stored).

eli-sdk: thanks, this looks like the estimator is not accounting for the tool output nor the system prompt in some cases. Our current estimator uses a lightweight tokenizer applied only to the messages passed to the SDK call and, historically, excluded tool-returned strings when those returns were delivered via tool callbacks. The API usage is the ground truth for billing.

jordan-eng: are we sure the tool output is billable? It was generated by our hosted tool runner.

alex-billing: yes — per billing policy any generated output (assistant messages, tool outputs, system messages) that the model returns to the user is billable as part of the response tokens. Invoice and dashboard ingest from metering pipeline which reads the API usage object.

sarah-cs: customer says they relied on the SDK estimator to forecast usage and were surprised by the delta on the invoice. They're asking whether this is a bug in the estimator or expected behavior.

eli-sdk: action plan: 1) quick fix: ship estimator update that includes tool-output tokens and system messages by default (v0.9.3-pre). 2) follow-up: expose a config flag `include_tool_outputs` and `include_system_messages` so teams can opt-in/opt-out. 3) docs + changelog. I can cut a PR today.

jordan-eng: for triage, can you attach the raw request/response JSON + headers (we have x-request-id). If deps allow, capture the full websocket/tool callback logs so we can attribute where the bytes came from.

sarah-cs: pasted the webhook logs in the attached ticket (link redacted). Here's the function call flow we saw: user -> system prompt -> user prompt -> model triggers `call_tool` -> tool returns 560B JSON string -> model emits assistant message with tool output included. SDK estimator only counted up to the tool call boundary and not the returned payload.

ops-oncall: suggestion — add an API debug mode `?token_breakdown=true` that returns per-message token counts in the response (system, user, assistant, tool) so customers and SDKs can reconcile quickly. This would help support and billing disputes.

alex-billing: I'll hold on a billing adjustment until engineering confirms whether estimator bug or expected behavior. If engineering confirms API is correct and SDK underestimated, we should notify the customer and offer a one-time goodwill credit pending adoption of the fixed SDK.

eli-sdk: I'll open the PR and a follow-up internal RFC for the estimator semantics. Probable timeline: PR today, internal review 24-48h, publish patch + changelog within 3 business days. I'll also add a diagnostic call `client.debug_token_estimate(messages, include_tool_outputs=True)` to help repros.

sarah-cs: leaving these notes on the customer ticket and asking them to try the debug-estimate when the patch is out. Customer asked for an interim explanation we can share now — I'll say: "API usage is authoritative; estimators are heuristics and currently undercount tool/system outputs in some SDK versions."

jordan-eng: quick ask for follow-up: add automated unit tests that replay a tool-return scenario and compare estimator vs API usage; add an integration test that validates estimator within +/- 5% of API for typical prompts.

alex-billing: tagging this for billing review after eng confirms. I'll also prepare a short customer-facing FAQ blurb about estimator limits.

ops-oncall: leaving a :eyes: reaction on the plan.

eli-sdk: noted. assigning to myself and will post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:

sarah-cs: thanks all — marking as customer-impacting and will ping when customer acknowledges the plan. :white_check_mark:
